label: Ubiquiti PowerBeam 5AC Gen2 (PBE-5AC-Gen2)
description: High-gain 5 GHz airMAX AC point-to-point radio, 450+ Mbps; 1x GigE port, integrated dish.
notes: Vendor figures from the PowerBeam AC Gen2 datasheet: **(1) 10/100/1000 Ethernet port**, **passive PoE on pairs 4,5+/7,8-**, 24 V 0.5 A Gigabit PoE adapter included, 20-26 VDC input, 802.11ac 2x2 at 867 Mbps. **Corrected against the datasheet**: the entry carried no power method at all, so it read as a plain unpowered radio - this box has no DC jack, and **passive 24 V is not 802.3af/at**, so a standard PoE switch will not power it. The M-series PowerBeams beside it are fast ethernet; this one is gigabit.
